digest.component_or_area: attestation plan-review validity and pin enforcement
propositions: When enforce_plan_material_pins is true, pin drift, malformed pins, or missing pinned targets invalidate plan-review attestations and block claim-gate, idempotent reuse, and progressive refresh.
When enforce_plan_material_pins is false, the same pin issues are reported as advisory in DerivedPlanReviewHealth while attestation remains valid.
Legacy unpinned attestations and pre-feature sidecars are treated as valid regardless of enforcement configuration.
Configuration read failures fail open returning false with structured warning plan_material_pin_config_unreadable without raising.

resign_plan_review validates reviewed_related_material from sidecar records and blocks re-sign only when enforcement is enabled and pin issues exist, preserving the existing own-material staleness guard.
Full LLM review threads the pre-LLM review_snapshot.related_material through sidecar.emit and build_payload as optional reviewed_related_material field on plan_review_result_v2.
